items.title: Fable 5.2 one-shotted my nephew's dream game
items.snippet: Article URL: https://notesbylex.com/fable-5-2-one-shotted-my-nephews-dream-game Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50433659 Points: 82 # Comments: 56
items.summary: The article recounts how the generative AI tool Fable 5.2 successfully built a complete, playable version of a child's dream video game from a single prompt. This milestone illustrates the dramatic speed at which AI tools are automating software generation and game development. It highlights how complex creative ideas can now be transformed into functional products almost instantaneously without manual coding.
key_points: Fable 5.2 generated a functional game end-to-end in a single prompt based on a nephew's concept.
Generative AI capabilities are expanding from simple code snippets to full application and game architecture.
The barrier to entry for game design and software creation is dropping rapidly for non-technical creators.

items.title: Horible public key tricks
items.snippet: Article URL: https://maurycyz.com/projects/badcert/ Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50434264 Points: 7 # Comments: 1
items.summary: This article explores unconventional and potentially dangerous techniques involving public key cryptography and digital certificates. It highlights how subtle manipulations of public key structures can bypass standard security assumptions. Understanding these edge cases is critical for developers and security engineers aiming to harden their systems against validation flaws.
key_points: Exploration of obscure public key and certificate manipulation tricks.
Potential security vulnerabilities resulting from unexpected cryptographic edge cases.
The importance of strict validation when implementing public key infrastructure.

items.title: Jensen Huang reportedly engaged a PR firm with a history of handling high-profile sex scandals a year ago
items.snippet: The PR firm was enlisted shortly after an October 2025 New York Times report described Alice Huang's business dealings with Jensen Huang, Wired reported.
items.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang reportedly hired a crisis PR firm known for managing high-profile personal scandals around a year ago. The decision followed an October 2025 media report examining business dealings related to Alice Huang. The engagement highlights the ongoing corporate governance and public relations strategies surrounding top tech executives.
key_points: Jensen Huang engaged a specialized crisis management PR firm roughly a year ago.
The hiring followed a New York Times report regarding Alice Huang's business dealings with Jensen Huang.
The revelation reflects heightened media scrutiny and strategic reputation management at the executive level.
